title: Texas notice filing for Rule 506 offerings
rule: For a Rule 506 offering with sales in Texas, the issuer gives the Texas Securities Commissioner a notice on Form D when it files with the SEC, and no later than 15 days after the first sale in Texas. The fee is one-tenth of 1% of the offering amount, capped at $500. The notice and the fee both go through NASAA's EFD system. The notice stays effective until the offering is completed or terminated.

citation.authority: 7 Tex. Admin. Code 114.4(b)(1) and (f)(5); Tex. Gov't Code 4006.052

changeWatch: Texas State Securities Board rule changes to Chapter 114 or fee changes in Chapter 4006.
